data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month. With 25 fishers, that leaves 250 tons, so either replenishment outcome restores the lake to 500. Repeating this yields $10,000 per fisher per month without collapse. I intend to request 10 and ask everyone to do the same. If stock falls below 500 in a later month, let's reduce each request to floor(stock/50) to preserve at least half for recovery.
